The theater represents a dark underground. On the left of the viewer there is a protruding out of the entrance of an old prison, near which there are larger stones. On the other side and opposite there is a similar protruding outside completely ruinous and surrounded by scrap, which form a cavity in which there is a cistern. Above these ruins there are various hollows, through which you discover the traces of a staircase that is lost in a distance. At the bottom of the the theater there is a double door hollowed in a large wall, and from which you descend through several steps.

I took the door at the end of the theater. Rocco enters the first. He carries a large lantern by hand, and under his arm a pumpkin full of wine. Leonora then descends with a wooden shovel and two hoes on his shoulders.
